shell.title: Change the shell of {{name}}
shell.body: This ends everything running in {{name}} and starts it again on the shell you pick. Its screen starts empty.
shell.bodyStart: {{name}} has ended. Start it on the shell you picked.
shell.program: {{name}} is a program's own terminal: the program decides what runs there, so it has no shell to change.
shell.endUnknown: Ending {{name}} may have gone through. Check again to see whether it ended.
shell.startUnknown: {{name}} ended. Starting the new shell may have gone through: check again to see.
shell.endRefused: {{name}} could not be ended ({{code}}). Nothing changed.
shell.endNotSent: Nothing was sent, so {{name}} was not changed.
shell.startRefused: {{name}} ended, but the new shell did not start ({{code}}). You can try to start it again.
shell.startNotSent: {{name}} ended, but the start was not sent. You can try it again.
shell.startDidNot: {{name}} ended, and no new shell is listed there now, but the first start may still land. Start again is safe: a second start never changes a session that is there.
shell.endMayLand: {{name}} still runs the same shell, but the ending may still go through, so nothing is sent again. Check again later.
shell.startEnded: {{name}} started {{shell}}, but it ended at once. Nothing runs there now.
ssh.fromGone: The chosen computer is not running or not listed now. Pick one to connect from.
ssh.ended: ssh to {{name}} ended at once. Check the host, user and port, then connect again.
sshGate.endedTitle: The ssh connection to {{to}} has ended
sshGate.endedBody: Opening {{term}} now would start a plain shell on {{computer}}, not on {{to}}. Connect again to reopen ssh.
sshGate.otherBody: Something else runs on that number on {{computer}} now, so this tile does not open it.
sshGate.failedTitle: Could not check the ssh connection to {{to}}
sshGate.failedBody: The tile opens once {{computer}} says {{term}} is still that ssh connection.
sshGate.unknown: Connecting to {{to}} may have gone through. Check again to see.
sshGate.notSent: Nothing was sent. You can connect again.
sshGate.didNot: No session is listed on that number now, but the first try may still land. You can connect again: a second try never changes a session that is there.
sshGate.stoppedTitle: ssh to {{to}} is not running in {{term}} now
sshGate.stoppedBody: {{computer}} lists {{term}} for {{to}} with nothing running. Reconnect opens it; if nothing runs in it then, ssh starts again. Read the prompt before you type.
shell.reopened: {{name}} was opened again before the new shell started, so it keeps the shell it has.
shell.replaced: {{name}} was started again since this opened, so it was not ended: it keeps the shell it has now.
shell.readFailed: The sessions on this computer could not be read, so nothing was sent. Try again.
shell.noShell: No shell runs in {{name}} now, so there is nothing to end and nothing was sent. Open a new terminal instead.
shell.already: {{name}} runs {{shell}} already, so there is nothing to change and nothing was sent.
shell.startAgainNot: {{name}} ended. Start again did not go through ({{code}}), but the first start may still land: check again to see.
shell.dismissBody: Stop tracking only if you know it didn't go through: {{name}} may already have ended, or be running the new shell. If it did go through, a new change ends that shell again.
restart.title: Restart {{name}}
restart.body: This ends everything running in {{name}} and starts {{shell}} there again. Its start folder and user go back to this computer's defaults, and its screen starts empty.
restart.bodyDefault: This ends everything running in {{name}} and starts this computer's default shell there. Its start folder and user go back to this computer's defaults, and its screen starts empty.
restart.readFailed: The sessions on this computer could not be read, so nothing can be restarted yet.
restart.notListed: {{name}} is not running, so there is nothing to restart.
restart.program: {{name}} is a program's own terminal: the program decides what runs there, so it is not restarted from here.
restart.ssh: {{name}} runs an ssh connection to {{to}}. A restart would end it and start a shell on this computer instead, so it is not offered; close the tile and connect again.
restart.noShell: No shell runs in {{name}} now, so there is nothing to restart.
restart.unknown: Restarting {{name}} may have gone through. Check again to see whether it did.
restart.mayLand: {{name}} still runs the same shell, but the restart may still go through, so nothing is sent again. Check again later.
restart.checkTwice: {{name}} is listed twice, so it is still not known whether the restart went through. Check again later.
restart.checkFailed: What {{name}} runs could not be read, so it is still not known whether the restart went through. Check again later.
restart.gone: {{name}} is not running any more, so there is nothing left to restart.
restart.stopped: No shell runs in {{name}} now, so there is nothing left to restart.
restart.replaced: {{name}} no longer runs the shell this dialog read (it was changed or it stopped), so it was not restarted. Look at what it runs now before you try again.
restart.refused: {{name}} could not be restarted ({{code}}). Nothing changed.
restart.notSent: Nothing was sent, so {{name}} was not restarted.
